create_eagle_engine: create an sglang LLM engine with EAGLE speculative decoding using sgl.Engine
run_eagle_batch_inference: run batch text generation on prompts using EAGLE speculative algorithm with llm.generate
configure_speculative_params: configure EAGLE speculative decoding parameters like speculative_num_steps and speculative_eagle_topk
set_draft_model_path: set the speculative draft model path for EAGLE speculative decoding
generate_with_cuda_graphs: run batch inference with CUDA graph optimization using cuda_graph_max_bs parameter
